## Download
- [Windows x64 ZIP]({{DOWNLOAD_URL}})

## Getting started
Extract the ZIP file, then run `SysmacVariableBackupViewer.exe`.

Requirements: Windows x64. The .NET runtime is included.

## Changes
### Added
- Load matching SMC2 projects to display POU names and variable, array element and member comments.
- Filter by POU and inspect original identifiers, values and comment sources in a compact detail pane.

### Changed
- Compact English UI with loading status, explicit Global scope and raw identifiers before project loading.
- Updated application icon and standardized application error messages in English.

### Fixed
- Preserve REAL/LREAL precision and extreme TIME values.
- Correct array indexes, global variable names, comment matching and native multi-cell copying.
- Prevent stale filter results and reject incomplete backup XML.
- Accept supported release tag prefixes consistently.
